Artifact.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.version === 0, s.name === "", s.manifest === ""].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.version >= 1, s.name !== "", s.manifest !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Artifact.DeletedStaysDeleted.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "deleted",
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.manifest === before.manifest,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Artifact.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[
					before.status === "",
					[
						[after.status === "", after.version === 0].every((ok) => ok),
						[after.status === "active", after.version === 1].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					before.status !== "",
					after.status !== "",
					[
						[after.version === before.version, after.manifest === before.manifest].every(
							(ok) => ok,
						),
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Artifacts.EveryArtifactVersionIsWithinIt.source:
(m) =>
			m.ArtifactVersionView.every((v) =>
				m.Artifact.some((a) =>
					[
						a.id === v.state.artifact_id,
						v.id === `${a.id}@${v.state.version}`,
						a.state.status !== "",
						v.state.version <= a.state.version,
						v.state.version !== a.state.version || v.state.manifest === a.state.manifest,
					].every((ok) => ok),
				),
			)

Artifact.ATokenIsOnlyOpenedOrDropped.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.publication_token === before.publication_token,
				before.publication_token === "",
				after.publication_token === "",
			].some((ok) => ok)

Artifact.ReservationsAreNumberedInOrder.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				after.reservations === before.reservations,
				[command._tag === "ReserveArtifact", after.reservations === before.reservations + 1].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Artifact.ClaimingAKeyChangesNoState.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				command._tag !== "ClaimArtifactIdempotencyKey",
				[
					after.status === before.status,
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.manifest === before.manifest,
					after.reservations === before.reservations,
					after.open_reservation === before.open_reservation,
					after.created_at === before.created_at,
					after.updated_at === before.updated_at,
					after.publication_token === before.publication_token,
					after.pinned_version === before.pinned_version,
					after.published_at === before.published_at,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Artifact.OnlyANewVersionChangesTheCapabi.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				command._tag === "CreateArtifact",
				command._tag === "AddArtifactVersion",
				after.capabilities === before.capabilities,
			].some((ok) => ok)
